summary: Regression smoke test after app.json identifier changes (name 'Aura'->'Aura 2', scheme 'frontend'->'auratwo', android.package/ios.bundleIdentifier -> 'com.emergent.auratwo.hltjsu'). The web preview boots cleanly with document.title='Aura 2', no red-screen or fatal console errors, expo-router tab navigation functions across all 5 tabs (Summary, Device, Flights, Sports, Weather), and no regressions were observed in the core flows. ZIP entry on Flights (10001) geocodes to 'New York City, NY · 40.748, -73.997'; Summary weather glance renders live Open-Meteo data ('83°F · Clear · H83° L64° · New York City') plus an NWS Flood Watch; AsyncStorage persistence verified (ZIP still '10001' after full page reload). Device tab shows connection pill + Brightness slider (80%) + Night Dimming toggle + Holiday Themes. Weather tab shows Alerts toggle, Time & Temperature card w/ toggle, Alert Chime, Second Location ZIP, and Minimum Severity chips. Backend testing was skipped per request (frontend-only). No expo/react-native deprecated-package or SafeAreaView issues introduced by this change. Bluetooth/ADS-B/ESPN 'needs phone app' hints show as expected on web and are NOT flagged as bugs per the review note.
action_items: None required for this iteration. The app.json identifier/name/scheme changes are safe – no code references the old 'frontend' scheme and expo-router deep links continue to resolve to (tabs) routes correctly.
(Optional, unrelated to this change) Expo doctor still notes 'expo@54.0.36 vs expected ~54.0.37' and 'expo-constants@18.0.13 vs ~18.0.14' – pre-existing package-version drift; not a blocker.
critical_code_review_comments: app.json is internally consistent: android.package and ios.bundleIdentifier both updated to 'com.emergent.auratwo.hltjsu', scheme set to 'auratwo', display name 'Aura 2'. No file in /app/frontend/app or /app/frontend/src references the old 'frontend://' scheme, so the scheme rename is a no-op for in-app navigation.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing AsyncStorage-persisted ZIP by typing 10001 during the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This iteration only verified that the app.json rename (name/scheme/android.package/ios.bundleIdentifier) did not break the running Expo web preview. If future changes touch expo-router linking config, re-check deep-link scheme handling. Native side-by-side APK install with the pre-fork build must be validated on a physical Android device – it is NOT testable in this container.
rca_of_issue: N/A – no bug found. The scheme change from 'frontend' to 'auratwo' is safe because the codebase does not construct or parse any 'frontend://' URLs (verified via grep). expo-router uses the scheme only for external deep-link entry, so navigation between (tabs) screens is unaffected.
